caption: Figure 2: Overview of UCCL-Tran extensible transport for GPU networking. We assume a common intra-server topology for GPU servers [23] where individual PCIe switches directly connect a few GPUs, NICs, and CPU, providing high-bandwidth data transfer among them.

files.source.svg: SVG extracted from the published PDF (PyMuPDF; text kept as <text>, fonts embedded)
files.print.png: the figure as extracted from the published PDF, at print size
files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from overview-with-inset by the note-writer: panel (b) is a different abstraction level (the threading model), not a magnified sub-block of a region in panel (a); no dashed leader connects them, so this is a plain two-panel figure.
templates.what_to_learn: The transferable move is two-panel's: stack a software layer directly above the hardware topology it runs on in panel (a), colour-code control/data/network traffic by one shared legend, then reuse the same component names in panel (b)'s separate threading-model view instead of drawing a zoom.

templates.why_chosen: PCIe switches, GPUs, and NICs each run '1 ⋯ 8' with an explicit last index inside this two-panel figure's hardware row, while panel (b) separately elides repeated connections and QPs.
templates.what_to_learn: Number the last replica explicitly (1 ⋯ 8) instead of using N when the paper's real hardware has a fixed, known count, and repeat that same ellipsis device at a second scale, connections or queue pairs inside one thread, when the implementation panel needs it too.

templates.why_chosen: Panel (a)'s legend (orange control-header, green data-payload, blue network traffic) traces flows through one concrete 2-CPU, 8-GPU server, while panel (b) switches vocabulary entirely to TX, RX, Pacer engine threads and per-connection queue pairs.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw a layered software stack directly above the physical server hardware it runs on so flows can be colour-coded end to end (orange control, green data, blue network), and repeat that legend in the internal threading panel too, since this figure leaves it unstated there, a listed weakness.
